prompt:

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. #3: A striking adult woman, mid 20s, with the glamorous Y2K 'Bratz' glam look: warm golden-tan skin with real visible pores and a shimmering highlight on the cheekbones, long sleek straight jet-black hair with teal streaks past her shoulders. Her eyes are huge, wide, saucer-shaped almond eyes, extra-large with a big visible iris in vivid ice-blue big-iris contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, framed by very bold, thick, long lashes and heavy pink-and-gold shimmer eyeshadow with a sharp winged liner, and thin, high, sharply arched brows. Her lips are extremely plump, big, glossy hot-pink lips with a darker pink lip liner outline and a pronounced cupid's bow, slightly pouting. A small, narrow, upturned nose, high sculpted cheekbones, and a small pointed chin. A sassy, confident, playful look straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

#3 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about eleven in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The face and ear jewelry is real pastel-enamelled gold set with white pearls, pastel gemstones, hearts and stars, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron.

Ear weights, for the women who wear weights in their lobes: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all four weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

Earrings: the large earrings of the women who wear them hang freely in the air down to the level of the collarbone and no lower, and no earring of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: each woman stands upright, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level, shoulder to shoulder and close enough that their shoulders and upper arms touch or slightly overlap in depth, leaning very slightly toward each other, so that the hanging pieces of one never hang in front of another and each woman's hanging pieces stay in front of her own shoulder. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: The background is a misty forest at dusk, soft blurred dark-green trees fading into pale fog, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:2 horizontal 8K.
